adversarial.expectation: a routing row that would let a lesson-derived answer bypass validate_linguistic_decisions gates must be rejected

positive.expectation: M5 (error diagnosis) routes to fusha_learner_feedback KC records with gate_wrap intact

commands.expect: every row names a gate_wrap; rows without gate_wrap fail
commands.purpose: emit candidate routing rows {method_id, concept_domain, cefr_band, existing_surface, gate_wrap}
commands.run: python - (inline: cross instructional-methods.md table with graph domain histogram + tools/fusha_cefr_gate.py bands)

defeaters: a produced row conflicts with a repo-certified fact -> record as contradicted, do not overwrite
the private corpus is unavailable -> metadata-only steps proceed; body-reading steps abort cleanly

conditions: a method requires tutor-surface changes (Sol-owned) — leave integration note
escalation_trigger.route: Sol integration review -> owner adjudication where a rule/status change is implied

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: never invent an example, answer key or analysis the source or an independent authority does not support; abstain and record the gap
evidence_policy.statement: evidence level: curriculum-source-supported (uncertified); every row cites its claim-ledger claim_id and manifest file_id (source + claim identity); lesson prose is read in private custody and never committed; committed rows are original restatements

expected_outputs.description: candidate method->surface routing rows with mandatory gate_wrap
coverage summary + integration notes for the tutor owner

guards: the METHOD transfers, linguistic conclusions never do: a lesson-derived pattern licenses a candidate row, never a resolved analysis at any occurrence
rival-analysis handling: any item admitting more than one admissible analysis is recorded with ALL alternatives (analysis-dependent / school-dependent), never side-picked
no candidate-to-certified automatic promotion: nothing this packet produces may carry status certified; only tools/certify_typed_fact.py certifies, after review, outside this packet

non_deployment.statement: All outputs are candidate-plane repo artifacts; no live surface, entry store, or public payload is touched; deployment is owner-gated elsewhere.

out_of_scope: editing curriculum/tutor-runtime-routing.md or tutor-session-protocol.md directly (Sol-shared tutor surface)
scope.summary: Map methods M1-M10 (crosswalk/instructional-methods.md) onto curriculum/tutor-runtime-routing.md's existing routing surfaces as ADDITIVE candidate routing rows: which method serves which concept domain at which CEFR level. The inverse gap (xn-10) is controlling: the curriculum has no abstention pedagogy, so every routed answer path must carry the gate ladder.
